text:
*While the battle for the city rages, you slip into the Duke's estate through the servant passages Thomas showed you. Goran will be in his study — the spider at the center of his web, pulling strings even as it all unravels.*

*The estate is eerily quiet. Most of Goran's guards have been sent to join the fight. Only a handful remain — and they're nervous, jumping at shadows.*

*You find Goran in his study, burning documents. The fire in the hearth blazes with the evidence of his crimes. He looks up when you enter — and for the first time, you see genuine fear in his eyes.*

Goran: "You. How did you — no matter. It's too late. Varketh is at the gates. Harren controls the harbor. You've lost, stranger. We've all lost."

choices.text: "It's over, Goran. Surrender and face justice."
Grab the documents before he can burn them all
Restrain him by force — no more words
